snippet.title: Aurora Defense: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Aurora Defense is coming out in Early Access on July 11, 2025.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183220?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=ealaunch&utm_content=datetrailer

A unique roguelike deckbuilder + base-building tower defense game. Build powerful defenses in the last bastion of light, fend off relentless waves of darkness, and protect the final goddess!
